# Two-stage evidence selection and answer composition

Local experimental vertical slice, not automatic truth verification. Preserve direct default,
existing prompts, scoped-v3, source corpus/contracts, pinned model/dependencies and prior artifacts.

Flow: retrieval/context snapshot -> deterministic sentence catalog with exact character offsets
and source SHA -> model selects up to 6 sentence IDs in strict JSON -> validate IDs/duplicates/
truncation -> model writes 2 answer entries with evidence IDs using selected sentences ONLY ->
validate schema, referenced IDs and exact source spans/hash -> publish answer with source quotations.
Model does not invent quotations; code resolves valid IDs to original text. This proves quote
membership, NOT relevance, completeness, correct negation, causal entailment, or answer truth.

Add --answer-mode direct/evidence-v1 to CLI and evaluator; direct remains default. Evidence mode
requires an explicit document or corpus. Search-only and retrieval refusals never load the model.
Sentence segmentation is a bounded punctuation heuristic (multiline spans preserved), max128 units.
Selector max128 tokens; writer uses existing bounded max-tokens; each prompt limited2048 tokens.
Same loaded model serves sequential stages; record actual messages, token hashes, output, elapsed
time, seeds/limits and validation status per stage, plus total inference cost. No retries/fallback.

Failure/recovery: empty selection abstains before writer. Malformed/duplicate/unknown IDs,
invented references or truncation cause explicit evidence_rejected with raw stage output retained.
Runtime failure in stage2 retains stage1 evidence and records pipeline_error before exit1. New UUID
on rerun; never overwrite earlier output. Errors/rejections stay in evaluation denominators.
Corpus snapshot used throughout a request; do not reread a mutable file between stages.

Maintainability: evidence.py owns catalog/contracts/orchestration with injected generator;
cli.py owns real MLX loading/generation and final persistence; evaluator forwards mode, validates
provenance and reports stage/rejection counts separate from retrieval and semantic manual grades.
All new executable modules enter source fingerprints. No arbitrary remote model code/dependencies.

Acceptance: happy path resolves quotes to exact selected source spans; altered span/hash rejected;
bad schemas/IDs/types/duplicates/truncation/empty selection cannot publish unsupported answer;
selection rejection cannot call writer; stage2 failure preserves earlier stage; original direct
behavior stays compatible. No claims of improved accuracy from structural pass alone.

Verification: unit and fake-backend integration for failure paths, evaluation CLI propagation,
full pytest/Ruff, independent OMC code and architecture reviews. Real qwen3-4b/scoped-v3/baseline
40-case development+challenge evaluation for evidence mode, with all25 positive selections and
answers manually inspected and15 refusal controls. Compare against existing direct baseline only
after matching model/settings/question/document hashes; scope this as historical baseline unless
fresh paired direct runs are performed. Record direct target smoke and same-command reproduction.
Do not silently tune selector/answer prompts after seeing quality scores; preserve failures.

Cost/scale: at most two serial calls after one load; sum tokens and generation duration, distinguish
stage timings from end-to-end latency. Corpus cap unchanged. Larger retrieval, service concurrency,
semantic validators and automatic regeneration remain outside this milestone.

measurements.scope: 25 model-executed cases including 3 rejected writers and 1 empty selector; sum stage costs. Not service latency or p95.

automatic_metrics.answer_quality: not_scored; review each answer against the rubric

manual_review.criteria: Unchanged dataset rubric; incomplete answers, structural rejection and selector abstention remain failures among 25 positives. Semantic content, selection completeness, quote membership, two sentences and Korean are separate.

이 문서는 학습용으로 작성한 예시이며 실제 기업의 장애 기록이 아니다.

멱등성은 같은 작업을 여러 번 수행해도 최종 효과가 한 번 수행한 것과 같은 성질이다.
데이터 파이프라인에서는 장애 후 재시도나 중복 이벤트 때문에 같은 데이터가 여러 번 처리될 수 있다.
멱등한 처리는 이때 결과가 중복 반영되는 것을 방지해 데이터 정합성을 유지한다.

예를 들어 같은 주문 이벤트를 재처리할 때마다 매출을 더하면 매출이 실제보다 커진다.

이 사례에서 중복 효과를 막을 수 있다. 재시도 자체를 금지하는 것은 장애 복구 방법이 아니다.

이 사례에서 중복 효과를 막을 수 있다. 재시도 자체를 금지하는 것은 장애 복구 방법이 아니다.
